lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and at least eight vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, creating a grid-like anchoring system for the constellation pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high reflectance on the upper edge and defined shadow-casting on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Four prominent vertical, linear lacerations or deep scarifications are visible across the gill slit region, disrupting the standard textural pattern of the gill plates.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, low-luminance elongated object, consistent with a commensal fish, is visible beneath the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
